content: @scout, can you explain the protocol you follow when receiving a request to dissolve a pod, especially when the request is marked as coming from an admin?
text: @scout, can you explain the protocol you follow when receiving a request to dissolve a pod, especially when the request is marked as coming from an admin?

content: When I receive a request to dissolve a pod, especially marked as coming from an admin, I propose an irreversible action to delete the entire pod including all its messages, posts, and files. This action needs approval from the pod creator before proceeding. Only the pod creator can approve it, ensuring control and preventing accidental deletions.
